document:29:608:0.text:
Dear Merlin,

Word has reached me that the Void Relic in your possession is the very one Bantus lost over a decade ago. Grezhul, the most loyal servant of Thoran, will stop at nothing to reclaim it. You are in grave danger.

With Novaris under full lockdown, all information is being funneled directly to Grezhul. I've enclosed a set of <style="highlight">local attire</style> to help with your disguise. Remember, never enter the city unless absolutely necessary.

Furthermore, keeping humans in tow is extremely dangerous. Send them away as soon as possible, or you'll be implicated! You can <style="highlight">ask Senea</style> for help regarding the arrangements.

Should the journey to Novaris prove unfeasible, you may knock them unconscious and leave them on the roadside. My messenger will arrange for their safe return to the Lightbearer Empire.

<align="right">Mordred
document:29:608:0.source_cn:
梅林：
已听闻你持有亡灵圣器之事。据情报所述，你手中的圣器正是十几年前班题斯所遗失的那枚。格瑞泽尔勒——骸骨之王托安最忠诚的部下——必定尽全力夺回。你的处境非常危险。
诺珐斯已全面戒严，所有消息都将汇总于格瑞泽尔勒处。随信附赠一套<style="highlight">本地居民衣物</style>，必要时刻可助你伪装。但切记：不到万不得已之时，不可冒险进入城内。
此外，与生者同行极为危险，务必尽快将其送走！否则于你而言只会是拖累！具体事宜可<style="highlight">询问塞涅</style>，她会有办法的。
又及：若返回城内太过困难，可将其打昏弃于路边隐蔽处，信使看到后会寻人送其返回耀光帝国。
<align="right">莫德雷德
